info.name: Nexora OS API
info.description: Nexora OS microservices API. All routes are served through the API gateway at {{base_url}} (http://localhost:3000). Authentication: Bearer token from Keycloak realm `nexora` (client `nexora-developer-portal`). Set the `token` collection variable to a valid access_token.

request.description: Returns access_token. Copy into the `token` collection variable.
